configurations.name: wt-dropdown-verify
configurations.comment: TEMP (local, do not commit): verify the dynamic provider dropdown from the claude/dynamic-provider-dropdown worktree. Loopback + throwaway secret + chat-only (no collectors/discord/mcp/tunnel). Absolute path so the preview tool (cwd=main checkout) runs the worktree's server. Provider API keys are NOT overridden here, so cloud options appear if the ambient env has them.

configurations.name: keystone-selfbuild
configurations.comment: TEMP (local, do not commit): isolated self-build worktree claude/keystone-self-build off origin/master. Lean loopback server — Discord/trader/MCP/tunnel/collectors all disabled. Absolute path so the preview tool (cwd=main checkout) still runs the worktree's server.js.

configurations.name: kalshi-tinder-verify
configurations.comment: TEMP (local, do not commit): kalshi tinder-game worktree claude/kalshi-tinder-game off origin/master. PAPER mode — KALSHI_TRADING_ENABLED is intentionally unset so every live order path resolves to dry_run. Discord/cloudflare/MCP off; collectors left ON so the deck has data; Alpaca trader off. Local-admin bypass so the gated terminal renders. Absolute path to the worktree server.

configurations.name: lantern-dev
configurations.comment: Preview-tool dev server: runs the main checkout's server from the project root (relative cwd, required by the sandboxed preview tool). The isolated C:/dev/lantern-os-dev worktree is launched separately by scripts, not by the preview tool. Uses server-dev.js (not server.js) so the launcher-injected PORT env var is stripped before boot, otherwise session-secret.js refuses to start (PORT set => non-loopback => SESSION_SECRET required). See docs/DEV-SERVER-WORKTREE.md.

configurations.name: lantern-verify
configurations.comment: Preview-tool verify server: server.js on an auto-assigned free port. When the launcher injects PORT, server.js would normally bind 0.0.0.0 + require SESSION_SECRET; we pin the host back to loopback and provide a throwaway loopback-only SESSION_SECRET so it boots on a fresh port even when 4177/4178 are taken by other sessions.

configurations.name: lantern-trader-verify
configurations.comment: Like lantern-verify, but grants the loopback local-admin bypass (LANTERN_LOCAL_ADMIN=1) so gated pages like stock-trader.html render in the preview browser without a Patreon login. Loopback-only + throwaway secret; direct un-proxied hits only.

configurations.name: lantern-cloud-verify
configurations.comment: Like lantern-verify, but boots the hosted CLOUD profile (LANTERN_TENANCY=cloud, ADR-0018) so the surface gate is observable: only chat/explore/help + the account shell are served; local-only surfaces (trading, work, admin) redirect to /. Loopback + throwaway secret + chat-only (no collectors).
